''See also: [[Kanatalia Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Kanatalia is the [[Alchemist's Guild|Guild of Alchemists]], an organization with a presence in various locations, including chapter houses and specialized workshops. These facilities vary significantly in design, ranging from domed structures to buildings featuring large glass rooftop tanks or glowing light fixtures. The guild maintains high standards for its members, including a formal Alchemical Academy and specific professional ranks such as journeymen. While some [[Alchemists|alchemists]] are highly experienced, others may be self-taught or part of amateur collections learning from professionals. The guild's activities include conducting experiments, investigating the illegal production of alchemical substances, and managing various supplies. Kanatalia has been known to perform experiments on inmates within [[Imperial]] prisons to alter their mental and physical states, specifically aiming to increase docility or modify behavior. The organization is led by a [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] and maintains strict protocols regarding access to its workshops.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Kanatalia serves as a location where individuals may pursue an apprenticeship and is home to a chapter house. The area is capable of producing modern devices, though it is also a site for legal scrutiny, such as when Kanatalia investigated [[Ulrich Fletcher|Fletcher]] for the manufacture of illicit substances. During certain events, [[Meia]] was left under the care of this location.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Kanatalia]] investigated [[Ulrich Fletcher|Fletcher]] for manufacturing illicit substances.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c2">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Kanatalia]] is a place where one can be an apprentice.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Kanatalia]] has a chapter house.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c7">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Meia]] was left in the care of [[Kanatalia]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c8">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Kanatalia]] is a location that may produce modern devices.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c12">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
